'''Siralt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. He was on board the [[Turbulent-class Star Destroyer|''Turbulent''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|star destroyer]] [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']] during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] and replaced [[Quille]] as Grand [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. He didn't believe [[Darth Caedus]] could stay in power after the confrontation he and [[Cha Niathal]] had and believed him totally discredited after not recognizing Niathal's authority.
